top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by induced proximity (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) is a genuinely new principle, removal instead of inhibition, with quantitative design rules (ligand, linker, ternary-complex cooperativity) reproduced across independent laboratories. The citation can be held to the mechanism and not the clinical pipeline, and Ciulli as third name gives one coherent subject. P001 (C-N coupling) is the safer, cleaner-credit fallback, ranked second; P004 and P003 follow on credit and in-cell maturity concerns; any award is preferable to none.
